description: This file defines a PHP class 'BuzzLikeOnShareSearchFilterParams' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Buzz\Dto'. The class extends a base class 'FilterParams' and encapsulates search filter parameters specific to querying 'like' actions on shares in the OrangeHRM system, including setting and getting the 'shareId' and defining allowed sort fields.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class for filtering search results related to 'likes' on shares, allowing setting of share ID and sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class, setting the default sort field to 'shareLike.likedAtUtc'.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the 'shareId' filter parameter.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the 'shareId' filter parameter to filter results for a specific share.
